title: Planning puts a kb root's _anchors.csv in the touches of a content item that rewords a cited DOC fact, and its worker re-anchors it
goal: An item whose touches name a kb root's article and whose goal rewords or adds a DOC fact has that root's _anchors.csv in its touches at planning (as the doc2query expansions.csv rule does), precheck warns of one that lacks it, and the worker brief says to re-anchor the reworded lines with factdiff.py anchor --file. Retrospective of SP-tcis5f23: BG-7amw5rq6 and BG-bwlmvhq7 (and the goal research) reworded DOC facts without _anchors.csv in their touches; BG-7amw5rq6's worker left line 39 unanchored on purpose, and the review found the reworded postgres and nftables facts unanchored and three nftables rows orphaned (ST-ko6bkda5).
